purpose: Adapt unresolved-density amplitude and shape to observable cube-level domain shifts without simulation labels or locked truth

data.historical_simba_policy: CV0-15 was inspected after V7 and therefore is not an independent V8 test. It remains excluded from V8 feature fitting, training, checkpoint selection, and hyperparameter tuning, and is reported only as a conservative cross-code stress test.
data.eagle_policy: The 156 reserved cubes in config/hong2021_eagle_confirmation_seal_v1.json remain unopened until TNG/SIMBA development gates and the historical SIMBA stress test pass; EAGLE confirmation32 is the new independent V8 test

model.feature_weighting: Equal-source moments from TNG train and SIMBA CV16-23 development train
features: occupied count mean and standard deviation
occupied radial-velocity mean and standard deviation
deterministic mean-field cube mean and standard deviation
model.context_injection: MLP added to the time embedding of every residual block
model.initialization: V7 EMA backbone plus zero final context layer; exact V7 function at step zero

screening.score: Maximum absolute natural-log deviation from one across the two high-k total-power ratios and residual-RMS ratio in both development domains

confirmation.criterion: All eight unchanged field-gate checks pass in both TNG and SIMBA CV24-26 development domains
confirmation.fallback_if_failed: Declare V8 failed; do not inspect the sealed EAGLE confirmation

frozen_sequence: Train on TNG plus SIMBA development train only
Select among retained checkpoints using TNG and SIMBA CV24-26 development gates
Require unchanged full TNG and SIMBA CV24-26 development field gates
Run the historically inspected SIMBA CV0-15 cross-code stress test without using it for model selection
Only then open a predeclared subset of the 156 reserved EAGLE cubes once as the new independent test
Run grid-HOP only if all applicable field gates pass
forbidden: feature fitting on validation or locked data
checkpoint selection on historical SIMBA CV0-15 or sealed EAGLE
threshold relaxation after inspecting a failure
